description: VMap1 Power Plants Transmission Lines is a data set deposited in Harvard Dataverse by its authors National Geospatial-Intelligence Agency. This datalayer is a polyline coverage representing power transmission lines located throughout current VMap1 geographic coverage areas. Features in this layer have an FACC (Feature and Attribute Coding Catalogue) Code of AT030 defined as, "Power Transmission Line: A system of above ground wires including their supports, which transmits electricity over distance." This layer was derived ... Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2011. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is terms recorded on the dataset page: For educational, non-commercial use only. Although this data set has been developed by the NGA no warranty expressed or implied is made by them as to. Caveats: written from the Dataverse search and dataset metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-hdv-repository.
